scope: Qwen3-8B current frozen dual .05 vs far .05; Qasper200 existing V1 run and fresh RULER MultiKey2 65536 n100; gates-off auxiliary; no latency claim

implementation.procedure: Independently inspect adapter, current source, EOS+newline min2, YaRN2, independent gates, actual indexer/cache receipts.
implementation.acceptance: No protocol confounds; K1=128/K2=1024/tail32 and skip behavior bound.

reference_boundary.procedure: One 64K real request full node-cache vs native DynamicCache generated IDs; CPU EOS regression.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact generated IDs; stop behavior matches existing RULER.

data_integrity.procedure: Rebuild100 IDs/input token hashes from source; verify all300 arms, source hashes and checkpoint identities. Current Qasper200 verified separately.
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing/duplicates/mixed identities; all raw data mapped.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute substring reference scores, decisions at strict .05, profiles, byte/token conservation and paired bootstrap seed42 10000.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite values, correct0-100 units, exact independent score recomputation.

measurement_validity.procedure: Paired100 same input each arm, same model/rope/stop/config; primary Dual-Far.
measurement_validity.acceptance: No cherry picking; report activation; user tolerance3pp descriptive, not equivalence.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent verifier reruns CPU scoring/tokenization and checks smoke native parity, source/model/input hashes and environment.
reproducibility.acceptance: Independent scoped review required; explicitly note no second full GPU rerun.
